mapper.sql: coa.id AS id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(egroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM egroups WHERE egroups.id IN (SELECT egroup_id FROM crm_opportunity_activity_egroups WHERE crm_opportunity_activity_id = coa.id)) AS employeeGroupName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM crm_opportunity_stags WHERE crm_opportunity_stags.id IN (SELECT crm_opportunity_stag_id FROM crm_opportunity_stag_activities WHERE crm_opportunity_activity_id = coa.id)) AS stageName, coa.name AS activityName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM crm_opportunity_tasks WHERE crm_opportunity_activity_id = coa.id AND is_active = 1) AS taskName, coa.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, coa.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM crm_opportunity_activities AS coa LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = coa.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = coa.modified_by

WHERE coa.is_active = 1
AND coa.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity_activities SET name = #{activity.name}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{activity.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{activity.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE crm_opportunity_activities SET is_active = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_tasks(crm_opportunity_activity_id, name, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{name}, NOW(), #{userId}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity_tasks SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE crm_opportunity_activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.select: SELECT egroup_id FROM crm_opportunity_activity_egroups WHERE crm_opportunity_activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT crm_opportunity_stag_id FROM crm_opportunity_stag_activities WHERE crm_opportunity_activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT name FROM crm_opportunity_tasks WHERE crm_opportunity_activity_id = #{activityId} AND is_active = 1
